# EvidoraX

> AI-powered evidence extraction tool that converts research paper PDFs into structured PICO and GRADE data tables, with every field cited to its exact source sentence.

## What it does
EvidoraX helps researchers, clinicians, and systematic reviewers extract:
- Population, Intervention, Comparator, Outcome (PICO) elements
- GRADE certainty ratings (risk of bias, inconsistency, indirectness, imprecision, publication bias)
- Raw effect sizes, confidence intervals, and sample sizes

from clinical trial and research PDFs, using a three-pass AI pipeline that verifies every extracted field against the original source text.

## Who it's for
Systematic review teams, guideline committees, clinicians, and research analysts who need to extract structured evidence data from primary literature without manual data entry.
